item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las dregs pa'i rngam zlog byad ma sgrol byed
item.coloph: dregs pa'i rngam zlog byad ma sgrol byed zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs bcud/ stang chen dmu tsa'i rno mdel/ byad ma sgrol byed rno mtshon zhes bya ba/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
